content.title: About
content.content: Frozen strawberries are ripe berries harvested at peak season, quickly frozen at low temperatures to preserve flavor, aroma, and nutrients. The berries are usually trimmed of stems and leaves before being packed in airtight bags.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Strawberries are one of the most popular berries worldwide, cultivated in over 30 countries.
Freezing occurs within minutes of harvest, retaining up to 90 % of vitamin C.
Frozen strawberries are commonly used in smoothies, desserts, and sauces.
Antioxidant levels, such as anthocyanins, remain high after freezing.
In the United States, more than 1.5 million tons of frozen strawberries are consumed each year.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system and aids collagen synthesis.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Anthocyanins and flavonoids help combat free radicals and reduce inflammation.

items.title: Low‑calorie food
items.content: A 100 g serving provides about 30 kcal, making it an excellent choice for weight management.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion and contributes to satiety.

items.title: Supports heart health
items.content: Phytonutrients can help lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels.

items.title: Berry allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to strawberries.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Strawberries contain natural sugars; people with diabetes should monitor portion sizes.

items.title: Freezing quality
items.content: Improper storage can cause ice crystal formation and texture loss.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Frozen strawberries can be added to smoothies, yogurts, oatmeal, baked goods, sauces, and ice cream. They can be slightly thawed in the refrigerator or used directly in hot dishes.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep frozen strawberries in their original airtight bag at –18 °C or lower. After opening, transfer to a sealed container to prevent moisture and odor absorption. Use within 12 months.
